description: 9-point 2D star stencil applied iteratively on an NxN grid with ping-pong buffers. Emits per-pass kernel times; effective memory bandwidth is derived downstream.

non_scaling_params.name: iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Number of stencil time-steps per trial

non_scaling_params.name: trials
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed trials for averaging

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Thread-block dimension for stencil kernel (block_size x block_size threads)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
